Which statement explains why sulfur, S, has similar chemical properties to selenium, Se?
A
They both have the same number of electrons in their outer electron shell.
B
They are both solids at room temperature and pressure.
C
They are both non-metals.
D
They both form negative ions.

options.label: A
options.text: They both have the same number of electrons in their outer electron shell.

options.label: B
options.text: They are both solids at room temperature and pressure.
